teams.teamUpIntro:
Let's study and work
You are welcome to contact me anytime

Medal-focused team-up. Seeking (1) BC/RL or modeling/data strength and (2) full-stack/demo engineering. I bring reproducible kaggle-environments 1.32.7 evaluation, paired-seat replay diagnosis, fail-closed packaging, and honest ablations. No private code before an official merge.

I’m looking for teammates to join me in this competition.
I’d love to collaborate on ideas, run experiments, and improve our solution together. My goal is to learn from each other while working toward a strong result.
All experience levels are welcome.
